title: Intel View notes import (v1)
description: Clipboard/interchange format for creating notes in Intel View. Paste a document of this shape onto a project canvas to create its notes. Spec: docs/note-import-format.md.

source.description: Name of the producing tool, shown in the import confirmation.

ref.description: Local identifier, unique within the document. Only needed if another note lists it in `parents`.

type.description: Built-in: standard, log, url, ip, email, command. Any other slug is a software/service type (e.g. ssh, http).

content.description: Markdown. For url/ip/email it must be exactly one valid URL / IP address / email address.

version.description: Software/service version. Only allowed on non built-in types.

entries.description: Log entries, appended in order. Only allowed on type `log`.

oneOf.description: `ref` of another note in this document.
ID of an existing note in the target project.

children.description: Nested notes, each created as a child of this note.
